headline: Record core EPS despite heavier catastrophe losses
summary_short: Chubb's Q3 2026 net income was $2.84B ($7.30 per share, +4.4% y/y) and core operating income $2.98B ($7.66 per share) on net premiums written of $15.1B, up 1.9%.
summary_long: P&C net premiums written rose 1.9% to $13.18B and the P&C combined ratio was 84.1%. Catastrophe losses were $705M versus $285M a year ago, while favorable prior-period development was $511M versus $361M. Pre-tax net investment income hit a record $1.79B, up 8.6%. Life net premiums written were $1.96B, up 1.4%. Book value per share was $191.43, up 5.1% from a year earlier, after $4.48B of after-tax investment portfolio losses in the quarter. Annualized ROE was 15.3%.
confidence_notes: Effective Q3 2026 Chubb redefined core operating income to exclude amortization of certain purchased intangibles; prior periods were restated, so y/y comparisons use restated figures. Combined ratio y/y comparison is not stated in the extracted passage.

drivers.explanation: Record investment income and higher favorable reserve development offset heavier catastrophe losses.
North America Commercial fell 2.7% while Personal rose 5.3%, Agriculture 5.1% and Overseas General 6.7%.
Pre-tax catastrophe losses rose to $705M from $285M a year earlier.
Excluding catastrophe losses, the current accident year combined ratio was 82.6%.
